subject: 明代北方府城：王府殿院模块（原创扩展）；具体构件断代（待考）。
footprint_basis: design/22 §3.4 明代对应骨架；本套件地域命名
prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Materialize this EXACT architect blockout as a Ming northern Chinese princely courtyard module, keeping geometry locked. Input silhouette and all ground axis directions must stay unchanged: ground22wide by18deep, front edge1.22222 times side edge, perfectly symmetric ground slopes +0.500 and -0.500, two pixels across per1pixel rise. On1536x1152canvas keep foundation vertices L188,610 F826,929 R1348,668 B710,349. Add realistic red plaster enclosing walls, central wood gate, rear ceremonial hall with green glazed tiles, red columns and restrained Ming painted beams; two grey tiled side wings. A modest princely residence, no imperial yellow. Intricate greybrick/woodgrain/tile details, realistic antique strategy-game painted style. Lower roof peaks as needed but NEVER alter ground shape, horizontal eaves axes or view angle. Paper-thin grey stone paving edge with fully visible three corners, all entrance steps inside polygon. Natural left-upper illumination, true transparent RGBA surroundings and margins. No background glow haze vignette, no people, text, logos, watermark, modern objects.

references.role: 精确2:1体块几何参考；仅作image_gen输入；已view_image

visual_review: 第3轮两候选选2；逐张view_image及放大底角检查。仅alpha裁去石铺外围，无变形补绘，柱脚/墙基完整；规范化成品底轴及占地比例通过。 修边只校正铺地外轮廓，内部砖缝/横梁未重投影；不等于完整3D投影验收。
source_point_semantics: 修边后可见石铺外缘L/F/R，坐标采用生成原图；raw_source_points保存裁前实测
selection_reason: 第二候选使用锁定体块生成，无首候选背景光晕；仅铺地外围可安全修边，manor裁边会损伤墙基故保留原底并登记超差。
negative: 排除项完整内嵌于prompt；工具无独立negative参数。
final_view_image_review: 第3轮两候选选2；逐张view_image及放大底角检查。仅alpha裁去石铺外围，无变形补绘，柱脚/墙基完整；规范化成品底轴及占地比例通过。 修边只校正铺地外轮廓，内部砖缝/横梁未重投影；不等于完整3D投影验收。
